entries.title: Psalms 147:1
segments: ¶Give praise to the Lord; for it is good to make melody to our God; praise is pleasing and beautiful.

entries.title: Psalms 147:2
segments: The Lord is building up Jerusalem; he makes all the outlaws of Israel come together.

entries.title: Psalms 147:3
segments: He makes the broken-hearted well, and puts oil on their wounds.

entries.title: Psalms 147:4
segments: He sees the number of the stars; he gives them all their names.

entries.title: Psalms 147:5
segments: Great is our Lord, and great his power; there is no limit to his wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 147:6
segments: The Lord gives help to the poor in spirit; but he sends sinners down in shame.

entries.title: Psalms 147:7
segments: Make songs of praise to the Lord; make melody to our God with instruments of music.

entries.title: Psalms 147:8
segments: By his hand the heaven is covered with clouds and rain is stored up for the earth; he makes the grass tall on the mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 147:9
segments: He gives food to every beast, and to the young ravens in answer to their cry.

entries.title: Psalms 147:10
segments: He has no delight in the strength of a horse; he takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

entries.title: Psalms 147:11
segments: The Lord takes pleasure in his worshippers, and in those whose hope is in his mercy.

entries.title: Psalms 147:12
segments: ¶Give praise to the Lord, O Jerusalem; give praise to your God, O Zion.

entries.title: Psalms 147:13
segments: He has made strong the iron bands of your doors; he has sent blessings on your children inside your walls.

entries.title: Psalms 147:14
segments: He gives peace in all your land, making your stores full of fat grain.

entries.title: Psalms 147:15
segments: He sends out his orders to the earth; his word goes out quickly.

entries.title: Psalms 147:16
segments: He gives snow like wool; he sends out ice-drops like dust.

entries.title: Psalms 147:17
segments: He sends down ice like raindrops: water is made hard by his cold.

entries.title: Psalms 147:18
segments: At the outgoing of his word, the ice is turned to water; when he sends out his wind, there is a flowing of waters.

entries.title: Psalms 147:19
segments: He makes his word clear to Jacob, teaching Israel his laws and his decisions.

entries.title: Psalms 147:20
segments: He has not done these things for any other nation: and as for his laws, they have no knowledge of them. Let the Lord be praised.
